text.p: NetLive Communications Inc said it appointed its chairman and director of technology, Michael Kharitonov, to the additional posts of president and chief executive officer.
Kharitonov replaces Laurence Rosen, who resigned to pursue other professional interests, NetLive said. Rosen has resigned from the board of directors of the company and as the company's treasurer.
Kharitonov is a co-founder of the company and has been the chairman of the board and director of technology to the company since April 1996.
NetLive Communications Inc designs and develops mission critical voice, video and data call center systems for Internet-based interactive communications and commerce.
